scope: Primary-source review for unfamiliar-case interpretation, matched visualization tasks and information, and practice/order controls
execution_policy: Read-only source inspection; no implementation, browser run, deployment, external communication, human study, or Gate 8 work.

primary_sources.title: A Nested Model for Visualization Design and Validation
primary_sources.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
claims_used: Visualization design and validation are separated into task/data characterization, abstract operations and data types, visual encoding/interaction, and implementation.
Upstream errors can cascade into downstream validation, so task and data assumptions should be explicit.
Evaluation method should match the level and threat to validity being tested.
primary_sources.gate7_use: Write each unfamiliar case as an explicit task with a frozen answer key and report instrument/replay checks separately from interpretation claims.
primary_sources.limits: Framework guidance only; no evidence about Looking Glass, its cases, or human participants.

primary_sources.title: Seven Guiding Scenarios for Information Visualization Evaluation
primary_sources.publisher: University of Calgary Technical Report 2011-992-04; later IEEE TVCG
claims_used: Evaluation goals include visual data analysis and reasoning, user performance, user experience, communication, collaboration, and automated evaluation.
The recommended sequence is to set the evaluation goal, select a fitting scenario, then choose methods and planned analyses.
Different goals require different outputs and should not be collapsed into a single generic evaluation result.
primary_sources.gate7_use: Keep answer correctness, evidence recovery, interaction traces, and any later human observations as separate outcomes.
primary_sources.limits: Survey/framework guidance; not an efficacy result and not a validation of this instrument.

primary_sources.title: Effects of Screen-Responsive Visualization on Data Comprehension
claims_used: The controlled study matched statement/data task factors across interfaces, piloted correctness and comprehensibility, and measured correctness, time, and replay count.
Interface order was counterbalanced and statement sets randomized to address order effects.
A complementary practical study used a different open-ended goal, showing why controlled performance and practical use should be reported separately.
primary_sources.gate7_use: Preserve matched facts and task demands across conditions; record tutorial/practice, order, replay allowance, and information availability; separate accuracy from time and interaction measures.
primary_sources.limits: Results concern that study's responsive interfaces and participants; they do not transfer automatically to unfamiliar geometric/reference cases or establish any Looking Glass effect.

derived_gate7_requirements.design: Before inspection, freeze case IDs, wording, source/input IDs, expected and acceptable answers, required evidence, and explicit insufficient-information outcomes; keep the answer key separate.
derived_gate7_requirements.status: Application design derived from sources; not an empirical result.

derived_gate7_requirements.design: Score answer-key correctness, evidence/dependency/reference recovery, and replay/interaction traces independently. Add actual human observations only if separately authorized.
basis: Lam et al. distinct evaluation scenarios
derived_gate7_requirements.status: Application scoring rule; no efficacy or comprehension claim.

derived_gate7_requirements.design: Record case version, available information, display mode, start state, tutorial/practice exposure, order, replay allowance, and hidden fields. For a future human study, match task demands and counterbalance/randomize order.
derived_gate7_requirements.status: Design control; no participant effect observed in this project.

derived_gate7_requirements.design: Conclude only whether the frozen instrument presents and scores the declared cases consistently under the audit. Keep human comprehension, general benefit, transfer, social coordination, emergence, and efficacy unresolved.
derived_gate7_requirements.status: Claim boundary required by project scope.

limits: No source establishes that the Looking Glass instrument is understandable, useful, or efficacious.
No human participants or human results are present in Gate 7.
A correct keyed answer or reproducible replay does not establish social meaning, collective emergence, authority, influence, or a geometry advantage.
The recommendations are application-specific requirements derived from primary methods sources and remain to be implemented/audited under the approved Gate 7 scope.
